messages.subject: Executive Value Proposition | Al Rajhi Bank | ESG, Institutional Relations & Strategic Partnerships
messages.body:
Dear Mr. Alquraishi,

I am writing to share a strategic value proposition prepared specifically for Al Rajhi Bank, together with my three-page executive CV.

I currently serve as Liaison Director, Social Responsibility Department, at AGM Inc., part of Zijin Mining Group. My mandate spans senior government and regulatory relations, ESG, corporate affairs, social performance, strategic partnerships, stakeholder strategy and executive advisory within a capital-intensive multinational operating environment.

Al Rajhi Bank's 2026 agenda strongly aligns with my experience. The Bank is executing its Harmonize the Group strategy while strengthening sustainable finance, ESG governance, stakeholder engagement and its contribution to Vision 2030. My background brings practical operating experience where regulators, government stakeholders, sustainability commitments, major projects, reputation and senior executive decisions intersect.

The attached brief identifies where I believe I could support Al Rajhi Bank, including ESG and sustainable finance execution, institutional stakeholder strategy, major-sector client readiness, strategic partnerships and executive issues management. It includes a 90-180 day action framework and my executive CV.

I would value a confidential discussion regarding senior opportunities where this profile could support the Bank's strategic priorities. If another executive owns the closest mandate across Sustainability, ESG, Corporate Affairs, Strategic Partnerships, Government Relations or international development, I would appreciate your guidance or internal referral.

Kind regards,

Ragunauth Ramsaroop
Liaison Director | AGM Inc., Zijin Mining Group
Georgetown, Guyana
+592 608 4735
ragunauthramsaroop@icloud.com

strategic_brief.title: Strategic Value Creation Proposition for Al Rajhi Bank
strategic_brief.executive_summary: Al Rajhi Bank is combining strong financial scale with a deeper sustainable finance, digital and stakeholder agenda under Harmonize the Group. My value proposition is to strengthen the institutional layer connecting ESG commitments, government and regulatory relationships, strategic partnerships, major-sector clients and executive execution. As Liaison Director at AGM Inc., part of Zijin Mining Group, I lead government and regulatory relations, ESG coordination, corporate affairs, stakeholder strategy and executive advisory in a regulated multinational operating environment.
strategic_brief.company_context: Al Rajhi Bank reported SAR 1.055 trillion in total assets and SAR 13.8 billion in net profit after Zakat in its Q2 2026 presentation. The same update reported an AA ESG rating, USD 6.9 billion in green syndicated loans, USD 2.0 billion in sustainable senior unsecured sukuk, USD 1.0 billion in social sukuk and solar systems operating across 61 branches. Its 2026 Allocation and Impact reporting also covers sustainable finance instruments supporting renewable energy, energy efficiency, water, affordable housing and other eligible projects. The Bank's continued strategy execution creates demand for strong ESG evidence, stakeholder coordination, institutional engagement and clear executive reporting.

opportunities.title: ESG Evidence and Sustainable Finance Execution
opportunities.rationale: As sustainable financing scales, leadership and investors need credible operating evidence, clear ownership and disciplined reporting across financed projects and internal commitments.
opportunities.how_i_can_help: I would support selected ESG workstreams by linking commitments to operating data, accountable owners, stakeholder expectations and executive reporting. My current role includes carbon-data traceability and renewable-energy stakeholder governance in a live industrial environment.

opportunities.title: Institutional Stakeholder Strategy
opportunities.rationale: Vision 2030 alignment, regulatory expectations and major financing activity create recurring interfaces with ministries, regulators, public entities and strategic partners.
opportunities.how_i_can_help: I would map priority stakeholders, decision pathways, engagement ownership and escalation routes around selected strategic initiatives, then establish concise executive briefs and commitment trackers.

opportunities.title: Major-Sector Client Readiness
opportunities.rationale: Corporate clients in mining, energy, infrastructure and industrial sectors face regulatory, environmental, community and local-content issues that influence financing outcomes and project execution.
opportunities.how_i_can_help: I would bring an operator perspective to selected sector or client workstreams, helping translate ESG and institutional requirements into practical implementation roadmaps.

opportunities.title: Strategic Partnerships and Vision 2030 Alignment
opportunities.rationale: The Bank's role in renewable energy, SMEs, housing and economic diversification creates opportunities for partnerships that connect commercial value with national development priorities.
opportunities.how_i_can_help: I would help structure stakeholder and partnership plans connecting business objectives with government priorities, investment institutions, industry partners and measurable development outcomes.

opportunities.title: Executive Issues and Reputation Readiness
opportunities.rationale: High-profile institutions need rapid factual alignment when regulatory, ESG or stakeholder matters carry reputation implications.
opportunities.how_i_can_help: I would establish concise executive issue briefs, evidence trackers, stakeholder-risk registers and escalation protocols for selected high-exposure matters.

days_0_30: Confirm priority business lines where ESG, government and stakeholder execution would create immediate value.
Map regulators, public-sector stakeholders, major-client dependencies and internal owners.
Review ESG evidence, stakeholder intelligence and executive escalation processes.
days_31_60: Select three to five priority pilots.
Build integrated stakeholder and ESG action plans with clear ownership and evidence requirements.
Create an executive dashboard covering institutional dependencies, commitments and emerging issues.
days_61_90: Launch pilot engagement and ESG execution plans with executive sponsors.
Connect selected commitments to operating evidence and management review.
Capture repeatable practices across sectors and business lines.
days_91_180: Scale effective practices into a common stakeholder and ESG execution toolkit.
Measure impact through decision-cycle time, issue closure, evidence quality and stakeholder outcomes.
Institutionalize concise reporting for external dependencies and strategic opportunities.

potential_impact: Stronger translation of sustainable finance commitments into credible evidence and accountable implementation.
Earlier visibility of regulatory and institutional dependencies around strategic initiatives.
Improved readiness for clients operating in complex regulated sectors.
More structured partnerships aligned with Vision 2030 priorities.
Higher-quality executive decisions through concise stakeholder intelligence and escalation.
background_relevance: Current Liaison Director at AGM Inc., part of Zijin Mining Group, with country-facing responsibility across government relations, ESG, corporate affairs, social responsibility and executive advisory.
Coordinates regulatory and reputation-sensitive matters across operations, environment, HSE, legal, finance, procurement, HR, security, aviation and technical teams.
Supports stakeholder governance around approximately 46-50 MWp of solar capacity and more than 80 MWh of battery storage.
Coordinated a carbon-accounting proof of concept linking physical operating data across fuel, electricity, material movement, production and other records.
Brings 12+ years across multinational mining, regulated financial services and commercial operations, supported by an MBA.
